profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: Accomplished Staff Software Engineer at Waymo with a robust history at Google, specializing in scalable system design and robust software development. Proven mentorship in leading software teams to deliver high quality code and innovative product solutions.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Tech Lead of Transportation-as-a-Service offboard backend system covering all ride hailing related needs.
- Designed and implemented Pickup/Dropoff ranking system that handles increasing number of ranking signals, collaborating with UX and app teams for result presentation and onboard system team for driving side signals.
- Designed and implemented robust and scalable offboard router server architecture to meet rapidly growing QPS and Waymo service area size, collaborating with onboard router team for deep integration.
- Led and mentored a team of software engineers in design direction and writing high quality & readable code through reviews and leading by example.
- Defined roadmap and vision for related space in collaboration with Product Managers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Google Matched Content within Google Display Network's Ads Quality division.
- Tech Lead of Display Ads' Matched Content team, boosting revenue to XXM ARR with XXXM queries/day.
- Oversaw internal recommendation backend development with a team of SWEs, ensuring efficient indexing & high quality scoring of over XXB web pages.
- Initiated and led Instant Indexing project, reducing indexing time for newly published docs from days to just an hour.

Worked on various projects within Search (2012-2014)
- Knowledge Engine for TV/Movies
- Search Latency Reduction
- Sochi Winter Olympic Knowledge Panel and Live Result
- Korean Search Refinements Improvement

positions.title: Senior Research Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Action Script virtual machine as a part of embedded GUI middleware solution for mobile devices that shows great graphic effects from user scripts.
- Supported for VxWorks & PPC environment, including JIT feature: Commercialized in Sharp multifunction printer.
- Native AOT compile: converting AS3 into C++ code, which is more efficient than JIT compiled code and has no dependency on target platforms as JIT does.
- Tamarin code update, which used in Digitalaria’s core engine: updated from old 2009-version and did refactoring on the periphery, analyzing huge amount of code.

Alternative Service for the Korean Military

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
Developed optimizer part of RDBMS Tibero as designing & implementing followings.
- Query Rewrite with Materialized View: transforming an SQL into an equivalent one accessing materialized views so that the execution becomes much faster.
- Machine calculated expression cost: automatically measure & calculate the cost for expressions in SQL that the optimizer requires for precise cost estimation.
- Partial sort: efficient partial sorting algorithm for case when data is too big to fit in memory.

Alternative Service for the Korean Military

positions.title: Infrastructure Developer
positions.description: Built a powerful set of analytical tools and an automated trade execution infrastructure, which the company was leveraging to pursue new trading opportunities.  Implemented & tested a trading strategy by simulating with historical data.
